text:
nina: FYI PR #5233 is failing snippet CI; several examples across generate/embeds/showcase use quoted numbers and legacy fields. Opening summary: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233

ralf: Saw the failure. The Ruby example in guides/quickstart uses `max_new_tokens: "50"` and the Go snippet shows `input` instead of `messages`. Those subtle differences break the cross-language snippet verifier.

priya: I can fix Ruby+Go. Which OpenAPI examples are out of sync?

nina: api-ref/generate.yaml and api-ref/embeddings.yaml both have example blocks that drifted from the canonical shapes. generate.yaml still shows `timeout_ms: 1000` in the example while the schema marks it optional/null. Also embedding response sample uses `vector` instead of `embedding`.

morgan: I spent a few mins tracing the lint output: primary failures are
- JSON bodies with numeric fields quoted
- `input` vs `messages` mismatch
- streaming examples emitting `{role,content}` envelope (should be SSE with `type`/`delta` payload)
- missing Content-Type header in curl snippets

priya: I'll prepare a tiny patch: convert quoted numerics to numbers, update Go example to `messages []Message{...}`, update Ruby to `messages: [{role: 'user', content: '...'}]` and add Content-Type header in curl. Also change embedding response `vector` -> `embedding`.

ralf: While you're at it, can you add a short comment in api-ref YAML near `timeout_ms` that clarifies it's optional and examples should omit it when not set? That has stopped many CI flakes.

priya: Yup. Also propose adding a docs-automation script under tools/docs-normalize that normalizes example JSON(YAML) payloads: coerce numeric-like strings to numbers, prefer canonical keys `messages` and `inputs` as alias note. I sketched it locally — should we include it in this PR or open follow-up?

nina: Prefer separate follow-up PR for the automation. For now keep this PR focused on immediate example fixes + a CHANGELOG note. Add a TODO comment linking the follow-up issue.

morgan: One new request from snippet CI: add a unit in snippet-linter that rejects quoted numerics in example JSON bodies (snip-test-062). If we add that test, we'll catch regressions early.

priya: Added test locally and ran docs-lint. Failures reduced from 12 to 2 (remaining ones are in community-contrib examples). Pushed commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/66b7a2f. Updated curl/python/ruby/go snippets and api-ref examples. Left a YAML TODO for timeout_ms.

ci-bot: build-docs #1405 started for branch fix/canonical-examples (triggered by priya)

ralf: Quick code review: left 2 small comments about consistent ordering of fields in examples (model, messages, max_new_tokens, stop). Not blocking. Also note we should prefer `messages` before `max_new_tokens` in examples since that mirrors SDK arg order.

priya: Addressed comments and force-pushed. Also added a CHANGELOG line under docs/changes.md referencing snip-062.

ci-bot: build-docs #1405 succeeded for branch fix/canonical-examples

nina: CI green. Huge thanks. For follow-up: open issue to add tools/docs-normalize and a checklist in docs/PR_TEMPLATE.md to remind authors to run snippet-linter locally before opening.

priya: Will open the follow-up issue and link it in the PR description. Closing out once merge completes.

morgan: Merged PR, :shipit:

ci-bot: docs deploy succeeded for commit 66b7a2f

nina: Thread closed. If community examples keep failing, we'll triage community-contrib separately.
